critical_code_review_comments: BuchungPage.jsx 344-376: clean Shadcn Select implementation. Sentinel '__any' kept entirely client-side via onValueChange callback that maps '__any' → ''. No native <option> renders any nested <span>, so the validateDOMNesting/hydration warning is fully eliminated (verified: 0 errors in console across full booking flow).

WhatsAppFab.jsx: well-structured component. Hidden-on-/admin guard via pathname.startsWith('/admin') is correct and verified. Phone digits sanitized via /[^\d]/g.replace which strips '+' and spaces before being injected into wa.me URL — produces '41795850085' as expected. Outside-click + Escape close handlers correctly cleaned up in useEffect return.
Minor (non-blocking): WhatsAppFab uses window.open(url,'_blank','noopener,noreferrer') — good for security. The new tab won't auto-close — that's WhatsApp Web/Mobile behaviour, not a bug.

Backend POST /api/bookings returns minimal payload {ok:true,id:...} — UI doesn't show location_slug back to the caller, but admin GET /api/bookings shows full record with location_slug correctly stored as 'einsiedeln' / null. Booking 'Buchung gesendet' confirmation visible at top-right of viewport across both DE+EN flows. UX is clean.
